22a37e3d79627fa33562ba04.src: This Agreement is valid for 12 months from the date of signing.
22a37e3d79627fa33562ba04.out: Tá an Comhaontú seo bailí ar feadh 12 mhí ón dáta a shínítear é.

32266e9f52151e97fcac55fd.src: The fee is 8,000, in the currency stated in the invoice, per month.
32266e9f52151e97fcac55fd.out: Is é 8,000 an táille, san airgeadra a luaitear sa sonrasc, in aghaidh na míosa.

3b941e2387ac134cdb7eec1d.src: Either Party may terminate this Agreement with 30 days' written notice.
3b941e2387ac134cdb7eec1d.out: Féadfaidh aon Pháirtí an Comhaontú seo a fhoirceannadh le fógra scríofa 30 lá.

40ff8fca3ee6c1fd1c5ad503.src: The Parties will try to settle any dispute by negotiation.
40ff8fca3ee6c1fd1c5ad503.out: Déanfaidh na Páirtithe iarracht aon díospóid a shocrú trí chaibidlíocht.

4d9f31af3857b960fa08e82e.src: For late payment, the Client pays a penalty of 0.1% of the unpaid amount per day, capped at 10% of that amount.
4d9f31af3857b960fa08e82e.out: Maidir le híocaíocht mhall, íocfaidh an Cliant pionós de 0,1% den mhéid neamhíoctha in aghaidh an lae, faoi theorainn de 10% den mhéid sin.

69eae328334b07aff3a18d6c.src: This Agreement is deemed renewed for the same term unless either Party gives notice 60 days before it expires.
69eae328334b07aff3a18d6c.out: Measfar an Comhaontú seo a bheith athnuaite don téarma céanna mura dtugann Páirtí fógra 60 lá sula n-éagann sé.

6f5697cbea4b0ca6321ac72e.src: Bright Line (the "Contractor") and Orion Group (the "Client"), together the "Parties", agree as follows.
6f5697cbea4b0ca6321ac72e.out: Bright Line (an "Conraitheoir") agus Orion Group (an "Cliant"), dá rá le chéile "na Páirtithe", comhaontaíonn siad mar a leanas.

8f1a41fa3f0ea701bdc09a51.src: The Contractor shall provide cleaning of office premises services, and the Client shall accept and pay for them.
8f1a41fa3f0ea701bdc09a51.out: Soláthróidh an Conraitheoir seirbhísí glanta áiteanna oifige, agus glacfaidh an Cliant leo agus íocfaidh sé astu.

926fc21c56ff9f1878c17692.src: Either Party may assign its right to payment to a third party after notifying the other Party in writing.
926fc21c56ff9f1878c17692.out: Féadfaidh aon Pháirtí a cheart chun íocaíochta a shannadh do thríú páirtí tar éis fógra scríofa a thabhairt don Pháirtí eile.

97d7a647e7bdd0fbff5211e2.src: The Contractor waives any interest for late payment by the Client.
97d7a647e7bdd0fbff5211e2.out: Séanann an Conraitheoir aon úis as íocaíocht mhall ón Chliant.

a8e8345148716279182e4427.src: Claims under this Agreement are subject to the statutory limitation period.
a8e8345148716279182e4427.out: Tá éilimh faoin gComhaontú seo faoi réir na tréimhse teorainne reachtúla.

b46ff57e1cc26379f64b9c0c.src: All notices are sent by email to the addresses the Parties have given each other in writing.
b46ff57e1cc26379f64b9c0c.out: Seoltar fógraí go léir trí ríomhphost chuig na seoltaí a thug na Páirtithe dá chéile i scríbhinn.

b773a31d02502b1e0f594ef8.src: The fee may be changed only by an amendment signed by both Parties.
b773a31d02502b1e0f594ef8.out: Ní fhéadfar an táille a athrú ach le leasú a shínífidh an dá Pháirtí.

bf3caae5320def19159f9dd9.src: Each Party's total liability is capped at the fees paid for the last three months.
bf3caae5320def19159f9dd9.out: Teorannaítear dliteanas iomlán gach Páirtí leis na táillí a íocadh le haghaidh na dtrí mí dheiridh.

dd10c6423f84b06e6db7f705.src: Liability for intentional breach is not limited by this Agreement.
dd10c6423f84b06e6db7f705.out: Ní theorannaítear dliteanas as sárú d'aon ghnó leis an gComhaontú seo.

e6fc5a1af1085753b1bdbba0.src: A dispute that the Parties cannot settle by negotiation is referred to the competent court.
e6fc5a1af1085753b1bdbba0.out: Cuirfear díospóid nach féidir leis na Páirtithe a shocrú trí chaibidlíocht chuig an gcúirt inniúil.

f9c2b0577ea01727d6959518.src: The Contractor begins providing services within a reasonable time after receiving the Client's request.
f9c2b0577ea01727d6959518.out: Tosóidh an Conraitheoir ag soláthar seirbhísí laistigh de thréimhse réasúnta tar éis iarratas an Chliant a fháil.

f9f23a25112183f92fa2d2c0.src: The Client pays within 120 calendar days of signing the acceptance certificate.
f9f23a25112183f92fa2d2c0.out: Íocfaidh an Cliant laistigh de 120 lá féilire ó shíniú an deimhniú glactha.

fe59c1f55d1d6961f7ebb610.src: Final settlement for the month is made on the basis of the signed acceptance certificate.
fe59c1f55d1d6961f7ebb610.out: Déantar socrú deiridh na míosa ar bhonn an deimhniú glactha shínithe.
